subject: Post-discovery alignment — short demo windows + comms plan
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery alignment — short demo windows + comms plan

Alex — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a 30‑minute intro demo with the right stakeholders.

Recap (from today)
- Primary use case: customer-facing summarization + clinical note embeddings for search.
- Top risks flagged: data residency and integration with existing EHR pipelines.
- Success criteria for demo: show latency at 95th percentile <= 250ms for typical docs, how inference will sit in a VPC, and a simple embed+search flow.

Proposed next step
1) 30‑minute product intro (high level + short live demo) with Product, Security and one Infra/Platform owner.
2) Prep: short pre-read and a focused agenda (attached).

I can host any of these 30‑minute windows (PDT):
- Thu, Jul 1 — 10:00–10:30 AM PDT
- Mon, Jul 5 — 2:00–2:30 PM PDT
- Tue, Jul 6 — 9:00–9:30 AM PDT

Ask: please confirm (a) which slot works, (b) who will join as Security and Infra/Platform, and (c) nominate an ops contact for procurement/security questionnaires so we can surface SOC2/retention details ahead of time.

Attached: discovery-notes.pdf (brief), demo-prep-agenda.md

Thanks — we’ll keep this short and tailored to your priorities.

—
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
https://redwood.ai
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@solsticehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@solsticehealth.com>, Mary Patel <mary.patel@solsticehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 12:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-discovery alignment — short demo windows + comms plan

Kimberly — great session today, appreciate the concise recap.

Quick answers:
- The Jul 5 2:00–2:30 PM PDT slot works best for our team (we're on Eastern, so that's 5:00 PM our time).
- Confirmed attendees: Jamie Lin (Security, will lead), Mary Patel (Platform/Infra). I’ll join as product owner.
- Ops contact: forwarding to our procurement inbox (procurement@solsticehealth.com) — they handle vendor onboarding docs.

A couple of asks on our side: could Priyom highlight VPC/network considerations and any quantization/latency tradeoffs during the demo? Also, we’d appreciate a 1‑page pre-read on data handling + retention before the demo.

Thanks — I’ll wait for the calendar invite.

Best,
Alex
Alex Moreno | Senior Product Manager
Solstice Health
alex.moreno@solsticehealth.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@solsticehealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery alignment — short demo windows + comms plan

Alex — thanks, Jul 5 2:00 PM PDT is good on our side. I’ll own the demo content for the technical portion.

Planned demo focus (30m)
- 0–5m: quick context & success criteria (Kimberly)
- 5–18m: live demo — inference flow, VPC private endpoints, and how prefix/KV caching reduces token cost (Priyom)
- 18–25m: security & compliance touchpoints + audit log visibility (Ben)
- 25–30m: next steps / action items

I’ll prepare a 1‑page pre-read on data handling and retention and drop it into the invite. If procurement forwards any vendor onboarding items ahead of time I’ll add the relevant SOC2/retention notes.

If Jul 5 becomes constrained, our fallbacks (both PDT) are: Jul 6 9:00 AM or Jul 1 10:00 AM.

Attaching the demo prep agenda as a markdown file for your review.

—
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

- Host: Kimberly Park (Redwood)

- Platform/Infra: Mary Patel
- Pre-read: demo-prep-agenda.md (attached) + 1‑page data handling doc arriving from Priyom later today

- Redwood: Priyom to upload the 1‑pager to the invite; Ben to surface SOC2 retention window specifics if requested
